justification: Ku-ring-gai DCP Part 20 (13 live rules) applies to development 'in, or immediately adjacent to, the rail corridor or a busy road' (p20-2) but reached every KRG house. New site condition rail_or_busy_road: the property lookup flags a lot within 3 m of the LEP SP2 railway zone or a listed busy road's cadastre corridor; a gate rule moves Part 20 to that condition.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/lib/rail-busy-road.test.ts __tests__/api/rail-busy-road-condition.test.ts; python -m pytest -q tests/test_gate_rules.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The flag is set for a lot across the street from the line, not set for a lot on the highway or backing onto the line, or the route serves condition rows without the flag.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: 13 Part 20 rows in the generic layer, served to every Ku-ring-gai house (DQ-143).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: KRG DCP Part 20 p20-2 text; measured distances: Pacific Hwy lots 0.00-1.34 m from the corridor; 33 Killara Ave 0.00 m from the SP2 rail zone; 43 Werona Ave 11.75 m.

pre_impl.existing_data: Same pattern as the Greenweb condition (#1408): lot from nsw_cadastre_lots, flag in property route, condition layer in for-property, gate rule.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Much of the North Shore line is held as ordinary lots, so the cadastre railway corridor misses it; the LEP SP2 railway zone covers all 62 sampled points.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One lib module, one data file with the DCP's road list and quotes, wiring in the same five places Greenweb used, one gate rule.

functions.name: apply_gate_rules
functions.input: gate rule krg_20_rail_or_busy_road for council ku_ring_gai
functions.output: 13 rows moved to condition rail_or_busy_road (dry run)
functions.if_none: zero matching rows means no rows are written at all

values.value: live: 1311 Pacific Hwy flagged; 33 Killara Ave flagged; 43 Werona Ave not flagged

break_it.scenario: A lot across the street from the line is flagged.
break_it.what_happens: A house not adjoining the corridor is shown Part 20.
break_it.how: 3 m tolerance; 43 Werona Ave at 11.75 m is not flagged (unit test).

break_it.scenario: The map service is slow or down at lookup.
break_it.what_happens: The lot's flag cannot be computed.
break_it.how: Flag left unset and the page shows a plain note, as for Greenweb.
break_it.repro: route test with the lookup failing

break_it.scenario: Unnamed stretches of a busy road corridor.
break_it.what_happens: An adjoining lot on that stretch is missed.
break_it.how: Recorded limit in the data file (Pacific Hwy 1/11, Mona Vale Rd 4/13 samples unnamed).

mutation_analysis: Agent tests: flag inside/outside lots and route serving; removing the condition from the route fails the route test.

post_merge.db_reset: Yes, AFTER deploy: derive_precinct_keys.py --council ku_ring_gai --only krg_20_rail_or_busy_road --apply.
post_merge.manual_verify: Live: 1311 Pacific Hwy Turramurra sees Part 20; a house one street back does not.

residual_risk: Each KRG lookup adds two map queries (10 s timeout); on a slow day the note shows instead of the rules. Boundary St / Horace St local-centre sections not placed.
